modules.responsibility: The initializer exports selected doctor, hospital, and patient models with their services for package imports.
The initializer exports HospitalGenerator for package imports; the other generators remain importable from their modules.
DoctorGenerator generates synthetic domain values through generate_specialty, generate_medical_school, and generate_certifications, using the required RNG, dataset, or clock basis.
HospitalGenerator generates synthetic domain values through generate_hospital_name, get_hospital_type, and generate_departments, using the required RNG, dataset, or clock basis.
MedicalDeviceGenerator generates equipment and maintenance values from healthcare datasets and links technician values to PersonGenerator.
MedicalProcedureGenerator generates synthetic domain values through get_procedure_name, generate_procedure_description, and generate_specialty, using the required RNG, dataset, or clock basis.
PatientGenerator generates synthetic domain values through pick_blood_type, generate_age_appropriate_conditions, and generate_insurance_provider, using the required RNG, dataset, or clock basis.
The initializer exports Doctor for package imports; the other healthcare models remain in their module paths.
Doctor combines professional identity and credentials with specialty, hospital affiliation, availability, and contact details.
Hospital represents a care facility with services, capacity, accreditation, operating attributes, and contact details.
MedicalDevice tracks equipment identity, assignment, lifecycle dates, status, usage, and maintenance history.
MedicalProcedure describes a coded clinical service with specialty, duration, cost, clinical flags, and recovery time.
Patient combines stable identity and demographics with clinical, body-measurement, insurance, and care-contact data.
The initializer groups the healthcare service classes for registry and package imports.
DoctorService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.
HospitalService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.
MedicalDeviceService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.
MedicalProcedureService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.
PatientService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.
Validates locale-backed specialty and license constraints, then generates doctor JSON from a DoctorRequest.
Generates patient JSON from locale-backed age and condition constraints, with optional profile-seed control and a stable identifier.

components.label: models
responsibilities: Expose lazy patient and doctor demographics plus hospital, procedure, and medical-device clinical and operational fields.
forbidden_responsibilities: Generate dataset values directly or own service orchestration.

requires.rationale: Healthcare entities delegate computed values to domain generators.

components.label: generators
responsibilities: Generate patient demographics and conditions, doctor credentials, hospital services, procedure details, and device lifecycle history.

components.label: services
responsibilities: Bind patient, doctor, hospital, procedure, and device generators to entity models and declare exposed fields and required datasets.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own generator algorithms or entity property behavior.

requires.rationale: Services delegate value creation to domain generators.

components.label: use_cases
responsibilities: Standalone deterministic JSON doctor and patient use cases.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own entity construction services or runtime execution.

rules.rationale: Each healthcare implementation module has one semantic owner; the package initializer is the source module.
Entities and services may consume generators; generator-to-entity and generator-to-service dependencies remain disallowed.
Expose entity/generator/service operations and the request types/functions consumed by the domain facade; expose the typed maintenance record used by MedicalDevice.
Healthcare ownership flows from generators to entities and services, without reverse generator dependencies.
Value algorithms; must not import entity models/services. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
Lazy domain entities; may call generators for computed values. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
Registered entity construction services. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
Standalone deterministic JSON use cases. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
